snippet.title: VS Art Timelapse - Arizona & Velvet
snippet.description:
It's raw power versus grace and skill in this explosive matchup! Watch Lindsay and ALT ART team up to create the newest promo art for the main roster, from thumbnail sketches to final rendering.

Timecodes
0:00 - Initial Sketches
2:00 - Arizona
7:11 - Velvet
10:52 - Final Image

ALT's portfolio: https://www.artstation.com/altart
Lindsay's portfolio: https://ltowns.com/

The final promo art is available in our media kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1t-CI-0pIcjsehCJWWDLlAHn1c98evP2u

Wallpapers here: https://mane6.com/media/#wallpapers

Love the soundtrack? Support the musicians and rock out to your favorite tracks: https://rc88.bandcamp.com/music
